info.title: LobbyStack API
info.description: Read calls, contacts, appointments and messages, book appointments, and subscribe to webhooks. Authenticate with an API key in the Authorization header. A platform key also names the business it acts on in the LobbyStack-Business header. Each key allows 120 requests per minute by default.

get.description: Returns the key and its business. Any valid key can call it, whatever its scopes, so integrations use it to test a connection. A platform key can call it without the LobbyStack-Business header.

parameters.name: LobbyStack-Business
parameters.description: The business a platform key acts on. Optional here: without it, business is null. A per-business key never needs it.

400.description: The request is invalid (invalid_request).

401.description: The API key is missing, invalid, or revoked (unauthorized).

403.description: Refused. forbidden: a per-business key named another business in LobbyStack-Business. key_owner_inactive: a platform key's owner_email has no verified LobbyStack account.

404.description: A platform key named a business it cannot act on (not_found).

429.description: Too many requests (rate_limited). Wait for the Retry-After header's number of seconds.

parameters.name: LobbyStack-Business
parameters.description: The business a platform key acts on. Required with a platform key. A per-business key may leave it out; if it sends one, it must be the key's own business.

post.description: Platform keys only. Creates a business owned by the account in the key's owner_email, and lets every key of the same partner act on it. Idempotency-Key is required: a retry with the same value returns the business it created, however much later, and a different body with that value is a 422.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. A unique value, up to 255 characters, that makes retries of this request safe.

401.description: The API key is missing, invalid, or revoked (unauthorized).

403.description: Refused. insufficient_scope: the key lacks the businesses:create scope. forbidden: only platform keys can call this endpoint. key_owner_inactive: a platform key's owner_email has no verified LobbyStack account.

409.description: The request conflicts with the current state.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body (idempotency_key_reused).

bearerAuth.description: An API key from Settings > API keys (lsk_...), which acts on its own business, or a platform key from the PLATFORM_API_KEYS setting (lsp_...), which onboards and manages businesses. Scopes: business:read, business:write, calls:read, contacts:read, contacts:write, appointments:read, appointments:write, messages:read, knowledge:read, knowledge:write, webhooks:manage, billing:manage, phone_numbers:manage, team:manage, businesses:create, users:create. Only platform keys can hold businesses:create and users:create.

prefix.description: The visible start of the key, for example lsk_1a2b3c4d, or lsp_1a2b3c4d for a platform key.

business.description: The business the key acts on. Always set for a per-business key. For a platform key, the business in the LobbyStack-Business header, or null when the request has none.

platform.description: Present only for a platform key.

partner.description: Who the platform key belongs to, as set in PLATFORM_API_KEYS.

access.description: all: the key can act on every business. partner: only on businesses its partner onboarded.

Me.description: The API key making the request and the business it acts on.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/Toronto.

locale.description: Default language for callers: en or fr.

business_type.description: What kind of business it is. The dashboard uses service_company.

onboarding_stage.description: Where the business is in onboarding, for example website, phone_number or complete.

booking_mode.description: instant: appointments are booked directly. request: the receptionist takes a request and the team confirms it. off: no booking.

items.description: One opening window on one day. A day with a break, such as lunch, has two windows. Days that are not listed are closed.

business_type.description: What kind of business it is.

hours.description: Replaces the whole week. Omit a day to close it. Send two windows for a day with a break. Windows on the same day can't overlap.

items.description: One opening window on one day. A day with a break, such as lunch, has two windows. Days that are not listed are closed.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/Toronto.

business_type.description: Defaults to service_company, the type the dashboard uses.

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Made from the name when left out. Another business already using it is a 409.

locale.description: Default language for callers: en or fr. Defaults to en.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/Toronto.

locale.description: Default language for callers: en or fr.

onboarding_stage.description: Where the business is in onboarding, for example website, phone_number or complete.

BusinessSummary.description: A business the platform key's partner onboarded.

slug.description: A short name no other service of the business uses.

active.description: Only active services can be booked. GET /services lists the others only with include_inactive=true.

staff_ids.description: The staff members who take this service. Empty means every active staff member does.

slug.description: Made from the name when left out, keeping only its Latin letters and digits, so a name without any needs a slug. One another service already uses is a 409.

duration_minutes.description: How long an appointment for it lasts, from 1 minute to 24 hours.

staff_ids.description: The staff members who take it. Leave it out, or send [], to let every active staff member take it. Inactive staff don't take bookings, so a service whose staff are all inactive can't be booked.

slug.description: One another service already uses is a 409.

active.description: false stops new bookings for it without deleting it.

staff_ids.description: Replaces who takes it. [] lets every active staff member take it. Inactive staff don't take bookings, so a service whose staff are all inactive can't be booked.

active.description: Only active staff members take bookings.

service_ids.description: Active services this person can be booked for. A service with no staff assigned is open to every active staff member.

Staff.description: A person who takes appointments. A business that never set up staff has one active staff member named after the business.

channel.description: phone: a phone call. web: a browser call from the website or dashboard.

summary.description: Short summary of the call, when one is available.

end_reason.description: Why the call ended, as reported by the call provider or receptionist.

summary.description: Short summary of the call, when one is available.

end_reason.description: Why the call ended, as reported by the call provider or receptionist.

locale.description: Language for the contact's reminders and confirmations: en, fr, es or sr.

anyOf.description: Language for the contact's reminders and confirmations: en, fr, es or sr.

source.description: Where the booking came from, for example voice, web_chat, dashboard or api.

starts_at.description: Start time. Use a starts_at value from GET /availability.

contact_id.description: An existing contact with a phone number. Provide contact_id or contact_phone.

staff_id.description: Book with this active staff member. Without it, LobbyStack picks one who is free.

sms_consent.description: True only if the customer agreed to receive confirmation and reminder texts. Self-hosted instances only: on LobbyStack Cloud, texts come from LobbyStack's shared number, and only the receptionist can collect that consent, on a call.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with a Z or numeric offset.

staff_id.description: Move the appointment to this active staff member. Defaults to the current one.

body.description: The full message as the team sees it.

greeting.description: What the receptionist says when it answers.

tone.description: How it speaks, such as professional or warm.

summary.description: What it tells callers the business does. Calls leave it out while summary_source is placeholder.

summary_source.description: placeholder: the default from sign-up. generated: written by AI from the business's knowledge. operator: written by a person or through the API, and AI never replaces it.

booking_policy.description: Rules it follows when it books.

transfer_mode.description: When it puts a caller through to transfer_number: never, always, on_request, on_urgent or during_business_hours.

transfer_number.description: Where it transfers calls, in E.164 format. A number saved before that was required may be in another format. With no number, it never transfers.

booking_mode.description: instant: appointments are booked directly. request: the receptionist takes a request and the team confirms it. off: no booking.

enabled.description: Whether callers can change their own appointments with the receptionist.

verification_mode.description: How a caller proves an appointment is theirs. phone_match_and_facts: their phone number and details of the booking. otp_required: a code sent by text. operator_only: the team makes the change.

appointment_change_policy.description: Whether callers can cancel or reschedule their own appointments, and how they prove it's theirs.

Receptionist.description: How the receptionist answers, what it says about the business, and what it may do.

summary.description: AI never rewrites a summary set here.

regenerate_summary.description: Hands the summary back to AI, which rewrites it from the business's knowledge. Can't be sent with summary.

transfer_number.description: null removes it, which stops transfers.

enabled.description: Whether callers can change their own appointments with the receptionist.

verification_mode.description: How a caller proves an appointment is theirs. phone_match_and_facts: their phone number and details of the booking. otp_required: a code sent by text. operator_only: the team makes the change.

title.description: The entry's title, or an FAQ's question.

content.description: The entry's text, or an FAQ's answer.

tags.description: Your own labels for the entry.

priority.description: Entries with higher numbers come first when the receptionist picks the entries it keeps ready on every call. Defaults to 0.

active.description: Whether the receptionist answers from it.

KnowledgeEntry.description: A text entry or FAQ the receptionist answers from.

title.description: The entry's title, or an FAQ's question.

content.description: The entry's text, or an FAQ's answer.

tags.description: Replaces the entry's labels. faq is reserved, because it marks an FAQ, so it is ignored here: an entry keeps its type.

active.description: false stops the receptionist answering from the entry without deleting it.

type.description: website: a site added as a source, whose crawl reads its pages. page: one page a crawl read, or a site that has no crawl of its own. file: an uploaded document.

url.description: The website's or page's address. Null for a file.

status.description: pending: a file waits its turn. processing: it is being read. indexed: the receptionist can use it. error or cancelled: reading stopped.

error.description: Why reading failed, when status is error.

active.description: Whether the receptionist answers from it. An inactive source stays indexed but unused.

page_limit.description: How many pages a website's crawl reads: a sample at first, the full site after POST /knowledge/sources/{source_id}/expand. Null for a page or a file.

KnowledgeSource.description: A website, page or file the receptionist learns from.

url.description: The site to read, such as https://example.com. A site that is already a source returns that source.

active.description: false stops the receptionist answering from the source without deleting it.

upload_url.description: Send the file's bytes here with PUT.

upload_headers.description: Send exactly these headers with the PUT.

expires_at.description: When upload_url stops working, about 15 minutes after it was made.

KnowledgeUpload.description: Where to send a file before completing its upload.

file_name.description: The file's name, such as prices.pdf.

content_type.description: PDF, Word (DOCX), plain text, Markdown, or a JPEG, PNG, WebP or TIFF image.

length.description: The file's size in bytes, up to 10 MB.

checksum_sha256.description: The base64-encoded SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

secret.description: Signing secret (whsec_...). Returned only when the endpoint is created.

id.description: Event id. Also sent as the webhook-id header; use it to ignore duplicates.
